title: These toddler-friendly pizza uncrustables come together in minutes
summary: Busy night? These toddler-friendly pizza uncrustables come together in minutes!
ingredients: Cooked chicken (I used plain rotisserie chicken from @sprouts)
steps: Add pizza sauce, chicken, broccoli, and cheese to one slice of bread.
Use a sandwich cutter/sealer (I used a heart shape!) or simply trim the crusts and press the edges together with a fork.

caption: 🍕❤️ Busy night? These toddler-friendly pizza uncrustables come together in minutes! All you need: • 2 slices whole wheat bread • @raoshomemade Pizza Sauce • Cooked chicken (I used plain rotisserie chicken from @sprouts) • Steamed broccoli • Shredded mozzarella cheese How to make them: ❤️ Add pizza sauce, chicken, broccoli, and cheese to one slice of bread. ❤️ Top with the second slice. ❤️ Use a sandwich cutter/sealer (I used a heart shape!) or simply trim the crusts and press the edges together with a fork. ❤️ Air fry just until the outside is lightly golden and the cheese is melted.
